mapper.select: /* 학생대시보드에서 게시판미열람수 조회쿼리 두개로 분리해야함 TODO:jinkoon 20260630*/ WITH REPLY_YN AS ( SELECT DISTINCT UP_ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND UP_ATCL_ID IS NOT NULL ), READ_YN AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD WHERE VWER_ID = #{userId} ) SELECT NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'NTC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS NOTICE_UNREAD_CNT, NVL( SUM( CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'QNA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) , 0 )AS QNA_NOREPLY_CNT, NVL ( SUM( CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = '1ON1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) , 0 ) AS ONE_ON_ONE_NOREPLY_CNT, NVL ( SUM( CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'DATARM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) , 0 ) AS DATARM_UNREAD_CNT FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA JOIN TB_LMS_BBS BBS ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = BBS.SBJCT_ID /* 교수 테이블과 학생 수강 테이블을 각각 LEFT JOIN */ LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM SA ON SA.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND SA.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = #{userId} /* 수강 테이블 컬럼명확인 필요 */ LEFT JOIN REPLY_YN RP ON RP.UP_ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID LEFT JOIN READ_YN RD ON RD.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID WHERE BA.DELYN = 'N' AND BA.UP_ATCL_ID IS NULL /* 교수의 과목이거나 학생이 수강중인 과목인 데이터만 필터링 (서로 겹치지 않게 방어) */ AND (SA.SBJCT_ID IS NOT NULL OR ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID IS NOT NULL)

/* 대시보드과정공지목록조회 (교수학생공통) : TOPIC - CRS_NOTICE, BADGE - 전체공지 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'CRS_NOTICE' TOPIC, 'CRS_NTC' BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD R WHERE R.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID AND R.VWER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END READ_YN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, ORG.ORG_ID, S.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON S.SBJCT_ID = BBS.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BA.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND BBS.BBS_TYCD IN ( 'CRS_NTC') ) WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 교수대시보드강의QNA목록조회 : TOPIC - PROF_DASH_LCTR_QNA, BADGE - 문의자이미지 썸네일 */
WITH REPLY_ATCL AS ( SELECT UP_ATCL_ID, MAX(ATCL_ID) AS ANSWER_ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY UP_ATCL_ID ) SELECT BASE.* , REPLY_ATCL.ANSWER_ATCL_ID ANSWER_ATCL_ID FROM ( SELECT 'PROF_DASH_LCTR_QNA' AS TOPIC, 'USER_IMAGE' AS BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID, NVL(U.PHOTO_FILE_ID, 'user_img') AS USER_THUMBNAIL FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BA.DELYN = 'N' AND BA.UP_ATCL_ID IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = BA.USER_ID WHERE BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'QNA' ) BASE LEFT JOIN REPLY_ATCL ON REPLY_ATCL.UP_ATCL_ID = BASE.ATCL_ID WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 교수대시보드일대일목록조회 : TOPIC - PROF_DASH_1ON1, BADGE - 문의자이미지 썸네일, 상담요청한 글만 출력*/ WITH REPLY_ATCL AS ( SELECT UP_ATCL_ID, MAX(ATCL_ID) AS ANSWER_ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY UP_ATCL_ID ) SELECT BASE.* , REPLY_ATCL.ANSWER_ATCL_ID ANSWER_ATCL_ID FROM ( SELECT 'PROF_DASH_1ON1' AS TOPIC, 'USER_IMAGE' AS BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID, NVL(U.PHOTO_FILE_ID, 'user_img') AS USER_THUMBNAIL FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BA.DELYN = 'N' AND BA.UP_ATCL_ID IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = BA.USER_ID WHERE BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = '1ON1' ) BASE LEFT JOIN REPLY_ATCL ON REPLY_ATCL.UP_ATCL_ID = BASE.ATCL_ID WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 학생대시보드전체목록조회 : TOPIC - STDNT_DASH_ALL_NOTICE, BADGE - 기관공지 + 과목공지 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'STDNT_DASH_ALL_NOTICE' TOPIC, CASE WHEN BBS_TYCD = 'CRS_NTC' THEN 'ALL' ELSE 'SUBJECT' END BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD R WHERE R.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID AND R.VWER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END READ_YN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, ORG.ORG_ID, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID
JOIN TB_LMS_BBS BBS ON ( BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID OR ( BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'NTC' AND BBS.BBS_ID IN ( BBS.ORG_ID || '_NTC_SBJCT', BBS.ORG_ID || '_NTC_ORG' ) ) ) AND BBS.BBS_TYCD IN ('NTC', 'CRS_NTC') AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BA.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = #{userId} ) WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 학생대시보드과목공지목록조회 : TOPIC - STDNT_DASH_SUBJECT_NOTICE, BADGE - 과목 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'STDNT_DASH_SUBJECT_NOTICE' TOPIC, 'SUBJECT' BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD R WHERE R.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID AND R.VWER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END READ_YN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, ORG.ORG_ID, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID
JOIN TB_LMS_BBS BBS ON BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.BBS_TYCD IN ('NTC', 'CRS_NTC') AND ( BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID OR BBS.BBS_ID = #{orgId} || '_' || BBS.BBS_TYCD || CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'NTC' THEN '_SBJCT' ELSE '' END ) JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BA.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = #{userId} ) WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 학생대시보드강의Qna목록조회 : TOPIC - STDNT_DASH_LCTR_QNA, BADGE - 문의자이미지 썸네일 */ WITH REPLY_ATCL AS ( SELECT UP_ATCL_ID, COUNT(*) AS ANSWER_CNT, MAX(ATCL_ID) AS ANSWER_ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY UP_ATCL_ID ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'STDNT_DASH_LCTR_QNA' TOPIC, 'USER_IMAGE' BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD R WHERE R.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID AND R.VWER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END READ_YN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID, NVL(U.PHOTO_FILE_ID, 'user_img') AS USER_THUMBNAIL, RA.ANSWER_ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_BBS BBS ON BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'QNA' AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BA.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN REPLY_ATCL RA ON RA.UP_ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = BA.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = #{userId} ) WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 학생대시보드자료실목록조회 : TOPIC - STDNT_DASH_DATARM, BADGE - 없음 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'STDNT_DASH_DATARM' TOPIC, 'NONE' BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD R WHERE R.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID AND R.VWER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END READ_YN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BA.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'DATARM' ) WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 관리자 대시보드 시스템공지목록조회 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ATCL.REG_DTTM DESC) AS RN , ATCL.ATCL_ID , ATCL.ATCL_TTL , ATCL.INQ_CNT , ATCL.REG_DTTM , USR.USERNM /* 시스템공지사항 작성자는 모두 '관리자'표기? */ FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL ATCL ON BBS.BBS_ID = ATCL.BBS_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATCL.RGTR_ID = USR.USER_ID WHERE BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'SYS_NTC' )X
WHERE X.RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 관리자 대시보드 모든공지목록조회 (과정공지, 과목공지) */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ATCL.REG_DTTM DESC) AS RN , ORG.ORGNM , ATCL.ATCL_ID , ATCL.ATCL_TTL , ATCL.INQ_CNT , ATCL.REG_DTTM , USR.USERNM /* 시스템공지사항 작성자는 모두 '관리자'표기? */ FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL ATCL ON BBS.BBS_ID = ATCL.BBS_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATCL.RGTR_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON BBS.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID WHERE BBS.BBS_TYCD IN ('NTC', 'CRS_NTC') )X
WHERE X.RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 과목최신공지사항목록조회 : TOPIC - SUBJECT_TOP_NOTICE, BADGE - 점 */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'SUBJECT_TOP_NOTICE' TOPIC, 'DOT' BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.OYN, BA.RGTR_ID, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD R WHERE R.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID AND R.VWER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END READ_YN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_BBS BBS ON BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'NTC' AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BA.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 과목최신강의Qna목록조회 : TOPIC - SUBJECT_TOP_LCTR_QNA, BADGE - 문의자이미지 썸네일 */ WITH REPLY_ATCL AS ( SELECT UP_ATCL_ID, COUNT(*) AS ANSWER_CNT, MAX(ATCL_ID) AS ANSWER_ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY UP_ATCL_ID ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'SUBJECT_TOP_LCTR_QNA' TOPIC, 'USER_IMAGE' BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD R WHERE R.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID AND R.VWER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END READ_YN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID, NVL(U.PHOTO_FILE_ID, 'user_img') AS USER_THUMBNAIL, RA.ANSWER_ATCL_ID, U.USERNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_BBS BBS ON BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'QNA' AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BA.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = BA.USER_ID LEFT JOIN REPLY_ATCL RA ON RA.UP_ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}

/* 교수과목최신일대일목록조회 : TOPIC - PROF_SUBJECT_TOP_1ON1, BADGE - 문의자이미지 썸네일 */ WITH REPLY_ATCL AS ( SELECT UP_ATCL_ID, COUNT(*) AS ANSWER_CNT, MAX(ATCL_ID) AS ANSWER_ATCL_ID FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL WHERE DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY UP_ATCL_ID ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'PROF_SUBJECT_TOP_1ON1' TOPIC, 'USER_IMAGE' BADGE, BBS.BBS_ID, BBS.BBS_TYCD, BA.ATCL_ID, BA.ATCL_TTL, BA.REG_DTTM, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL_INQ_RCD R WHERE R.ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID AND R.VWER_ID = #{userId} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END READ_YN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY BA.REG_DTTM DESC ) RN, ORG.ORGNM, SC.SMSTR_CHRTNM, S.SBJCTNM, S.SBJCT_ID, NVL(U.PHOTO_FILE_ID, 'user_img') AS USER_THUMBNAIL, RA.ANSWER_ATCL_ID, U.USERNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT S ON ADM.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_BBS BBS ON BBS.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = '1ON1' AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.ORG_ID = #{orgId} JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL BA ON BBS.BBS_ID = BA.BBS_ID AND BA.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = BBS.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = BA.USER_ID LEFT JOIN REPLY_ATCL RA ON RA.UP_ATCL_ID = BA.ATCL_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) WHERE RN <= #{limitTop}
